proof.text: Apply rationalProjectionPullTensorSquare to the prescribed proper and open tensor-pullback comparisons, using their integral and rational canonical normalizations. Prove that integral pullback followed by rationalization equals rationalization followed by rational pullback, using the unchanged-object and pure-tensor formulas of rationalDerivedPullback_existsUnique. The pull comparison is eqToIso of this equality by rationalModelNormalization. Normalize the supplied proper tensor-pullback comparison into operation coordinates. Its integral and rational homs equal the prescribed canonical homs heterogeneously. canonicalRationalPullbackTensor_existsUnique identifies the rational hom with localization of the integral hom. The tensor comparison is eqToIso of rationalProjectionTensorFunctorEq, so the resulting equality is the required tensor-pullback square through the specified endpoint comparisons.

Use a proved generic coefficient-projection calculation: transpose both projection paths under the rational pull/direct adjunction. Naturality of the pull comparison and its counit equation carry the localized integral transpose to the tensor-pullback square. Naturality of the tensor comparison moves the integral counit through it; naturality of the rational tensor-pullback comparison moves the direct-image comparison through the rational transpose. The tensor-pullback square identifies the results. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence gives equality of the two actual projection arrows. Normalize the supplied stage coordinates using their functor equalities and adjunction normalization, and expand properSource/properTarget to obtain the stated square.

title: Canonical localization carries the proper counit projection mate
statement:
theorem rationalProjectionTensorCompatibility_proper
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (H : SixFunctorHigherOperations D C E) :
      ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E Y.obj.left).map
            (compactSupportProperProjection H.integralExchange f K L) ≫
          (properTarget H.rationalization
            (rationalProjectionTensorComparison H) f K L).hom =
        (properSource H.rationalization
          (rationalProjectionTensorComparison H) f K L).hom ≫
          compactSupportProperProjection H.rationalExchange f
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E X.obj.left).obj K)
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E Y.obj.left).obj L)
